name: Taming the Beast
summary: Dazalar guides a night elf hunter through a second trial in Dolanaar. With an enchanted taming rod, you subdue a nightsaber stalker and learn how wild beasts differ.

sections.title: The Changing Nature of Beasts
sections.body: Dazalar teaches you that the forest's creatures do not all behave alike. Each species has its own temperament, and a hunter must learn to meet it on its own terms. Beneath Teldrassil's canopy, the next test brings you against beasts more cunning and predatory than webspinners.

sections.title: Subduing the Nightsaber
sections.body: Kaldorei revere nightsabers as sacred predators, fierce guardians, and companions of the Sentinels. With the taming rod, you face a nightsaber stalker and must keep a steady nerve and calm authority. Winning its trust shows you can handle a predator, not only the more docile creatures of the woods.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Dazalar sends you to tame a nightsaber stalker and learn how different predators behave. This is the second trial in the night elf hunter's training; the full three-part trial unlocks permanent beast taming.

faq.q: Where can nightsaber stalkers be found?
faq.answer: Nightsaber stalkers roam the wooded paths and undergrowth south of Dolanaar, in central Teldrassil.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the nightsaber stalker as my permanent pet?
faq.answer: No. The rod tames the beast only for practice. After you finish all three trials and return the rod, you learn to tame beasts permanently and choose a companion.
Dazalar, the hunter trainer in Dolanaar, gives you this instruction after you complete your first taming test.

faq.q: Why do night elves revere nightsabers so deeply?
faq.answer: Kaldorei have lived alongside nightsabers for millennia. Sentinels and Priestesses of Elune have used them as companions, scouts, and war mounts, and taming one marks a proud mastery of the woods.

faq.q: What comes after completing this task?
faq.answer: Dazalar gives you a final taming task involving another creature of Teldrassil. Afterward, he teaches you to tame, feed, and care for permanent companions across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to respect different animal temperaments before you earn a lifelong companion.
As a night elf, you meet a traditional milestone for woodland scouts: taming a nightsaber, a creature woven into kaldorei history and culture.
